name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Before I worked in software, I spent 15+ years cooking in restaurant kitchens. So when Slang talks about being a good host, I know what that looks like on a Friday night, and I know what a GM is juggling when a vendor asks for an hour of their time. That's the person on the other end of every rollout you run.

The implementation side is where I've spent the last decade. At Accelo, I built the plan for every new client: which systems change first, what depends on what, and who owns each step. Then I handed it to the delivery team and stayed on it with their executives. At Wix, I launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of target while running a team of 20. At Birdeye, I rolled products out across 15 to 20 partners and their customers, and kept all but one.

The part I care about most is making the next one easier. Every rollout teaches you something, and I turn it into a template, a checklist, or a better handoff, so the next customer gets a smoother launch than the last. I also build with AI every day, so Slang's product won't be a black box to me.
I'd like to help your restaurant groups go from pilot to every location without surprises. Got time for a call this week?
